screener_description: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd, incorporated in 1958, is part of the Pune-based Kirloskar group. The Co. is engaged in the business of Compression & Transmission segments. It also undertakes O&M services for Compression Packages and has also entered logistic services by operating RoadRailer trains for end to end transportation of goods. It serves a variety of sectors like Oil & Gas, Steel, Cement, Food & Beverages, Railways, Marine and other industries. [1] [2]
